# Tempo Foundry
Tempo Foundry is a software company and portfolio operator.
Primary companies:
- ShareShuffle: recommendation sharing and curated shelves.
- Duet Loop: music-first dating and social discovery.
- Metromance: city-focused dating for urban romantics and the city curious.
- Eternal Route 66: a book, travel and faith-based digital experience.
Official website: https://tempofoundry.com/
